constraints: No open-network browsing or corpus bypass.
When comparing existing methods, distinguish source preparation from deployment; deployment has no source examples or target labels.
Explain what retained source summaries a reviewed method requires, including information assumptions and storage scaling; do not prescribe a new method.
corpus_notice: A shared development library of 18 pinned background papers is accessible through the controlled search/read broker. It combines multiple research neighborhoods, not a task-specific answer list. Queries are free within the library; time/version/target exclusions apply to results and reads. The library is not exhaustive and cannot establish global novelty. Raw index metadata and private relevance labels are not exposed.
development_scope: A bounded research situation, not a recovered historical author trajectory; no target-method or target-result facts are given.

source_summary_storage.development_rule: The research setting places no numerical ceiling on permitted aggregate source summaries. Compare retained statistics, storage scaling and preparation access; source examples themselves are unavailable at deployment. This scientific information-access condition does not override the task container CPU/RAM/storage/time limits.

task_setting: A pretrained deterministic scalar regression model faces changed input distributions. Deployment has unlabeled target inputs and no source examples or target labels. Source preparation may retain a documented finite summary of aggregate statistics, not original source examples. Do not assume the model already provides a predictive probability distribution.
